subject: Re: HMC Swindles kickoff - resourcing + the June benchmark week
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing:

- Staffing: Wei 40%, Paloma 60%, Leilani 30%, Oyin 40%. Steady through the window, no changes planned.
- Day-to-day compute: preconditioner training and tuning fit comfortably on 8-16 titan-a100 GPUs best-effort.
- The big item: for the full benchmark sweep we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation - 384 accelerators for the week of 2026-06-29. Confirmed through the Infra Lead reservation process; that week is deliberately after the Vulcan maintenance window (June 22-24), so we shouldn't be exposed to it.

Env note from setup: the pipeline pulls in r-base plus a fresh tensorflow/probability clone, so Paloma is baking a container image this month - saves everyone the 'works on my venv' round trips.

No budget or headcount asks beyond the above.

Deshawn
